limits: Expected source spans derive from the ten supplied proposals and agent review, not a benefits specialist.
Both arms use the same topic aliases and source-selection intent; baseline routing selects component records and candidate routing selects groups.
The candidate adds grouped discovery summaries and guarded navigation; this is not an isolated summary-only causal experiment.
Source text outside declared expectations is reported as additional context, not automatically irrelevant.
No model answers, live source fetches, changed source versions or complete legal answerability claims.
Retain failures; do not tune the test questions after observing results.
